description: This Java class 'GeoUtil' provides geospatial utility functions such as calculating distances between coordinates and checking if a point is within a polygon, using external libraries like JTS and Spatial4j.

classes.name: GeoUtil
classes.description: A utility class for geospatial calculations including distance measurement and point-in-polygon checks.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two coordinates in specified units.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given coordinate point is within a polygon defined by a JSON string.

methods.name: unionToGlobalGeometry
methods.description: Unions multiple polygon geometries and subtracts holes if any.

methods.name: normalizePolygonsJson
methods.description: Normalizes polygon JSON data to a standard format.

methods.name: normalizePolygonsJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Recursively normalizes nested polygon JSON arrays.

methods.name: extractHolesFrom
methods.description: Identifies holes within polygons based on spatial relations.

methods.name: buildPolygonsFromJson
methods.description: Builds polygon geometries from JSON array data.

methods.name: buildPolygonFromCoordinates
methods.description: Creates a polygon geometry from a list of coordinates, handling special cases with only two points.

methods.name: parseCoordinates
methods.description: Parses JSON array of coordinate pairs into a list of Coordinate objects.

methods.name: containsPrimitives
methods.description: Checks if a JSON array contains primitive elements.

methods.name: containsArrayWithPrimitives
methods.description: Checks if a JSON array contains only arrays with primitive elements.
